// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// memory / algebra / shared borrowed and owned combinations
let view: shared (&readonly Packet) = packet;
//        ^^^^^^ keyword.other.modifier.ds

let owner: shared ^Packet = ^Packet.create();

type Base = BaseOf<shared ^Packet>;

type Reborrowed = WithAccess<&Packet, "exclusive">;

SpaceOf<shared Packet> satisfies "shared";
//      ^^^^^^ keyword.other.modifier.ds
//                     ^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.type.binary.ds

PlaceOf<Packet | local Packet | shared Packet> satisfies "ambient" | "local" | "shared";
//               ^^^^^ keyword.other.modifier.ds
//                              ^^^^^^ keyword.other.modifier.ds
//                                             ^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.type.binary.ds

WithAccess<&Packet, "exclusive"> satisfies &exclusive Packet;
//                               ^^^^^^^^^ keyword.operator.type.binary.ds
//                                          ^^^^^^^^^ keyword.other.modifier.ds
